rationale: A 48-year-old male farmer with poorly controlled type 2 diabetes presenting with multifocal osteomyelitis. Tissue PCR was positive for melioidosis and serial blood cultures grew B. pseudomallei with characteristic bipolar staining (E1 confirmatory). Treated with IV ceftazidime and oral cotrimoxazole with complete recovery -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Tissue sample for PCR for melioidosis was positive, and serial blood cultures grew Gram-negative bacilli, later identified as B. pseudomallei.

rationale: A 48-year-old male farmer in Sri Lanka with paddy field mud exposure presenting with septic shock, acute kidney injury, and multiorgan failure. Positive blood and wound swab cultures confirmed Burkholderia pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory) -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: On the 2nd day of ICU stay, the positive blood and wound swab culture reports for Burkholderia pseudomallei were available.

rationale: A 52-year-old diabetic male with pleural effusion, splenic cysts, and chest wall abscess with rib osteomyelitis. Pus aspirate culture yielded B. pseudomallei with characteristic cornflower colonies and bipolar staining (E1 confirmatory). Successfully treated with imipenem and cotrimoxazole -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Pus culture and sensitivity report came as B. pseudomallei with corn flower colonies [Figure 5] and bipolar staining safety pin appearance on microscopy [Figure 6].

rationale: A 44-year-old male farmer with diabetes presenting with a solitary liver abscess. Percutaneous aspiration and drainage yielded purulent material; culture studies grew Burkholderia pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Treated with IV meropenem and oral cotrimoxazole with complete recovery -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Culture studies revealed moderate growth of Burkholderia pseudomallei.

rationale: A 47-year-old male presenting with meningoencephalitis and comatose state (neuromelioidosis) following ear surgery. Cultures of ear drainage, CSF, and stereotactic brain biopsy all grew Burkholderia pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Treated with meropenem and cotrimoxazole -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: from both the CSF and brain biopsy samples, which were sent for a supplementary examination to the Bundeswehr Institute of Microbiology in Munich, B. pseudomallei was isolated.

rationale: A 50-year-old male who lived in Indonesia presenting with migrating pulmonary infiltrates. Bronchial washing culture grew B. pseudomallei, confirmed by API20NE, VITEK GNI card, and 16S rRNA gene sequencing with 100% homology (E1 confirmatory). Treated with ceftazidime and amoxicillin-clavulanate with full resolution -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: By biochemical examination of API20NE strip and VITEK GNI card (BioMerieux, Inc., Hazelwood, U.S.A.), the organism was identified as Burkholderia pseudomallei.
evidence_items.test_name: Bronchial washing culture and biochemical identification

rationale: A 12-year-old boy in Hainan presenting with pediatric suppurative parotitis. Pus aspirate from the parotid abscess grew colonies on blood agar confirmed as Burkholderia pseudomallei by VITEK-2 (>99% identification) and 16S rRNA gene sequencing (E1 confirmatory). Successfully treated with imipenem and TMP-SMZ -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: VITEK-2 suggested that the isolate was Burkholderia pseudomallei, with an excellent level of identification (>99 %), which was confirmed by 16S rRNA gene sequencing.
evidence_items.test_name: Parotid pus culture, VITEK-2, and 16S rRNA sequencing

rationale: A 41-year-old male with diabetes presenting with right knee septic arthritis, cavitary lung lesions, and liver hypodensities. Blood and joint aspiration fluid cultures both grew B. pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Treated with ceftazidime, levofloxacin, and cotrimoxazole with resolution -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Blood and joint aspiration fluid were sent for microbiological cultures both of which grew B. pseudomallei.

rationale: A 42-year-old female in Sri Lanka with infective sacroiliitis and intramuscular abscesses. Paired melioidosis antibody titers demonstrated a 16-fold rise from 1:640 to 1:10,240 (E2 criteria: demonstrable >=4-fold rise and high titer >=1:640 in endemic area) coupled with compatible multi-abscess deep musculoskeletal infection and complete cure on extended intensive meropenem and eradication cotrimoxazole -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Her Melioidosis antibody titers obtained 2 weeks apart increased from 1/640 to 1/10240.

rationale: A 36-year-old diabetic male presenting with lung nodules, septic shock, and diffuse intramuscular abscesses (pyomyositis). Blood culture incubated in special media isolated Burkholderia pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Treated with IV ceftazidime and oral cotrimoxazole with complete resolution -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Blood culture incubated in special media isolated Burkholderia pseudomallei.

rationale: An 82-year-old male with travel to the Philippines presenting with fever and a mycotic aneurysm of the descending thoracic aorta. Admission blood cultures prior to antimicrobial therapy grew Burkholderia pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Successfully treated with ceftazidime, Bactrim, and endovascular repair -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: On day 3, blood cultures drawn on the day of admission prior to antimicrobial therapy grew Burkholderia pseudomallei.

rationale: A 62-year-old Gabonese woman with diabetes presenting with a leg abscess, septic arthritis of the knee, and septic shock. Cultures of blood, wound, and synovial fluid grew gram-negative rods identified and confirmed as B. pseudomallei by MLST and whole-genome sequencing (E1 confirmatory) -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: After the patient's death, the Pseudomonas species was classified as B. pseudomallei (patient strain Gb100) and confirmed by MLST and whole-genome sequencing.

rationale: A 67-year-old diabetic male in Indonesia with a chronic ulcer/abscess on the right sole. Wound base culture yielded B. pseudomallei on Ashdown agar and nested PCR confirmed the 16S rRNA gene of B. pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Treated surgically and healed -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Microbiology examination on a swab sample from the wound base revealed B. pseudomallei.
evidence_items.test_name: Wound swab culture on Ashdown agar and nested PCR

rationale: A 48-year-old female presenting with a subcutaneous inguinal abscess mimicking tuberculosis. Aerobic culture yielded wrinkled colonies identified as B. pseudomallei by characteristic biochemical tests (oxidase-positive, motile, nitrate reduction, Polymyxin B resistance) (E1 confirmatory). Successfully treated with IV ceftazidime, cotrimoxazole, and doxycycline -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: The isolate was confirmed as B. pseudomallei by characteristic biochemical tests.

rationale: A 48-year-old immunocompetent male presenting with small bowel perforations, peritonitis, and lung infiltrates. Peritoneal purulent fluid culture grew colonies confirmed as B. pseudomallei by culture characteristics and standard biochemical methods (E1 confirmatory). Treated with imipenem, doxycycline, and cotrimoxazole with complete recovery -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: On 6th postoperative day, the organism was confirmed to be B. pseudomallei by the above-mentioned culture characteristics and standard biochemical methods
evidence_items.test_name: Peritoneal pus culture and biochemical identification

rationale: An 81-year-old male with diabetes presenting with acute pyelonephritis due to reactivation of latent melioidosis. Blood and urine cultures both grew aerobic motile Gram-negative rods identified as B. pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Treated with imipenem/cilastatin followed by oral TMP-SMX with full clinical improvement -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: We drew blood and urine cultures which both grew non-lactose fermenting, aerobic and motile Gram-negative rods which were identified to be B. pseudomallei.

rationale: A 58-year-old diabetic male presenting with splenic and psoas abscesses. Serology demonstrated a >4-fold IgG titre rise by Hcp1 ELISA, and psoas pus aspirate culture grew B. pseudomallei confirmed by BD Phoenix-100 and 16S rDNA PCR direct sequencing (E1 confirmatory). Treated with ceftazidime and cefixime with abscess resolution -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: The isolated strain was then subjected to BD Phoenix-100 Automated Microbiology System (BD Biosciences, Franklin Lakes, NJ), and identified as B. pseudomallei.
evidence_items.test_name: Pus culture, BD Phoenix-100, and 16S rDNA PCR sequencing

rationale: A 61-year-old male with alcoholic cirrhosis presenting with necrotizing fasciitis, splenic abscesses, and prostatic abscesses. Intraoperative tissue, prostatic aspirate, and serial blood cultures grew B. pseudomallei on Ashdown's media (E1 confirmatory). Treated with surgical debridement, imipenem, ceftazidime, and doxycycline -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Tissue (taken during surgery) and blood cultures grew B. pseudomallei susceptible to ceftazidime, amoxicillin/clavulanic acid, imipenem, chloramphenicol, and cotrimoxazole but resistant to ampicillin, amikacin, and gentamicin.
evidence_items.test_name: Tissue and blood cultures on Ashdown's media

rationale: A 43-year-old male with diabetes presenting with an anterior mediastinal mass and cervical lymphadenopathy masquerading as malignancy. Blood culture and bone marrow culture grew B. pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Successfully treated with IV ceftazidime followed by cotrimoxazole and doxycycline for 6 months -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Blood culture and bone marrow culture grew B. pseudomallei sensitive to amoxicillin-clavulanic acid, ceftazidime, piperacillin, cefaperazone-sulbactum, co-trimoxazole, doxycycline, tetracycline, meropenem and imipenem.
evidence_items.test_name: Blood culture and bone marrow culture

rationale: A 54-year-old Chinese tunnel worker in Laos with diabetes presenting with prolonged fever, splenic abscess, and splenic vein thrombosis. Blood cultures grew B. pseudomallei, confirmed by sequencing and MLST (E1 confirmatory). Successfully treated with IV imipenem followed by oral doxycycline and sulfonamides for 6 months -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: samples from two bottles showed positive in the second test for B. pseudomallei.

rationale: A 40-year-old female with SLE on immunosuppressants in Mauritius presenting with fatal septicemia and cellulitis after muddy flood exposure. Blood cultures grew dry, rugose colonies identified as Burkholderia pseudomallei by API 20NE (E1 confirmatory) -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: identified as B. pseudomallei by using API 20NE (BioMerieux, Marcy l'Etoile, France) with the profile 1156577.

rationale: A 65-year-old male with diabetes presenting with pneumonia, respiratory failure, and ankle cellulitis/abscess. Blood culture, endotracheal secretions, and ankle pus all grew Burkholderia pseudomallei identified via Microscan 96 SI (E1 confirmatory) -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: which were subsequently identified as Burkholderia pseudomallei in Microscan 96 SI (Siemens, Frimley, Camberley, UK).

rationale: A 58-year-old diabetic male presenting with lung opacities, respiratory failure, and left knee septic arthritis. Multiple blood culture sets grew Burkholderia pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Treated with imipenem followed by cotrimoxazole and doxycycline with clinical response -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Burkholderia pseudomallei was isolated from all these blood samples.

rationale: A 54-year-old Thai female with breast cancer receiving chemotherapy presenting with febrile neutropenia, septic shock, and hepatosplenic microabscesses. Two blood cultures and a urine culture grew Burkholderia pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Treated with ceftazidime and TMP/SMX with complete resolution of abscesses -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: On day 6, two blood cultures and a urine culture showed positive for Burkholderia pseudomallei susceptible to amoxicillin-clavulanate, ceftazidime, imipenem, and trimetroprim/sulfamethoxazole (TMP/SMX)

rationale: A 54-year-old male diabetic presenting with fever, arthritis, and a splenic abscess. Aspirate from the abscess revealed catalase- and oxidase-positive, gram-negative bacillus with bipolar staining and violet colonies with central umbonation in Ashdown's selective agar (Fig. 2), diagnostic of Burkholderia pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Treated with ceftazidime and co-trimoxazole -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: The aspirate from the abscess revealed catalase- and oxidase-positive, gram-negative bacillus with bipolar staining and violet colonies with central umbonation in Ashdown's selective agar (Fig. 2), diagnostic of Burkholderia pseudomallei.
evidence_items.test_name: Splenic abscess aspirate culture on Ashdown's agar

rationale: A 53-year-old diabetic farmer with fever for over 1 year and multiple splenic granulomas/abscesses unresponsive to antitubercular drugs. Splenic aspirate bacterial culture grew B. pseudomellei (E1 confirmatory). Treated with IV antibiotics and oral cotrimoxazole/doxycycline with full recovery -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: bacterial culture from the splenic aspirate grew B. pseudomellei and he was initiated on intravenous ceftazidime.

rationale: A 69-year-old male diabetic returned from Malaysia and Thailand presenting with severe pneumonia and septic shock. Both blood and bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) cultures revealed heavy growth of Burkholderia pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Treated with meropenem and TMP-SMX with excellent recovery -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Blood and BAL cultures revealed heavy growth of Burkholderia pseudomallei.

rationale: A 63-year-old kidney transplant recipient presenting with a left lung mass. Core-needle biopsy revealed primary lung adenocarcinoma co-existing with localized pulmonary melioidosis: Brown-Hopp stain showed bipolar rods with safety pin appearance and B. pseudomallei grew on tissue culture, with serum antibody titer of 1:1280 (E1 confirmatory). Melioidosis successfully resolved with ceftazidime and cotrimoxazole -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: The Brown-Hopp stain revealed a single cluster of gram-negative bipolar rods with safety pin appearance characteristics of B. pseudomallei.
evidence_items.test_name: Lung biopsy Brown-Hopp stain and tissue culture

rationale: A 47-year-old diabetic male presenting with intractable hiccups, weight loss, and multiple ring-enhancing splenic abscesses. Pus culture from ultrasound-guided splenic aspiration identified B. pseudomallei on VITEK2 automated system with metallic sheen on MacConkey agar (E1 confirmatory). Successfully treated with IV ceftazidime -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: B. pseudomallei was identified from the aspirate of the splenic abscess, using the VITEK2 with updated Advanced Expert System (AES) [Biomerieux, Marcy I' Etoile, France] automated system after an incubation period of 72 h.
evidence_items.test_name: Splenic abscess aspirate culture and VITEK2 identification

rationale: A 62-year-old diabetic male presenting with fever, pancreatitis, and acute splenic vein thrombosis. Blood culture revealed Gram-negative bacilli with safety pin appearance and metallic sheen on MacConkey agar, identified as B. pseudomallei by VITEK2 (E1 confirmatory). Successfully treated with meropenem, cotrimoxazole, and enoxaparin -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: After an incubation period of 72 h, using the VITEK2 (Biomerieux) automated system, the causative agent was revealed to be B. pseudomallei.

rationale: A 52-year-old diabetic painter in Bihar presenting with septic shock, multiorgan involvement, and multiple deep abscesses in lungs, prostate, shoulder muscle, and spleen. Blood culture isolated Burkholderia pseudomallei confirmed by VITEK-II Compact with 98 % concordance (E1 confirmatory). Treated with high-dose IV meropenem and cotrimoxazole -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: The identification was confirmed using the VITEK-II Compact system (bioMerieux, Marcy l'Etoile, France) with 98 % concordance.
evidence_items.test_name: Blood culture and VITEK-II Compact identification

rationale: A 54-year-old Thai farmer presenting with persistent fever, multiple small liver abscesses, and left portal vein thrombosis. Blood culture results showed Burkholderia pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Treated with ceftazidime, amoxicillin-clavulanic acid, and anticoagulation with complete recovery and recanalized portal vein -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Blood culture results showed Burkholderia pseudomallei.

rationale: A 46-year-old male nurse in New Caledonia presenting with pneumonia, acute renal failure, and septic shock. Blood cultures and cutaneous abscesses grew B. pseudomallei, confirmed by Pasteur Institute and 16S rRNA gene sequencing (E1 confirmatory). Treated with imipenem and TMP-SMX with recovery -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Blood culture grew an oxidase-positive, gram-negative rod, which was initially identified as a Pseudomonas sp. by the local laboratory but later confirmed as B. pseudomallei by the Pasteur Institute when the patient was transferred to the hospital in the capital city, Noumea.

rationale: A 58-year-old male business traveler to Thailand presenting with severe pneumonia and septic bacteremia. Blood cultures flagged positive; initial standard library MALDI-TOF suggested B. thailandensis, but 16S rRNA gene sequencing definitively identified Burkholderia pseudomallei (99.8% match; E1 confirmatory). Successfully treated with ceftazidime and TMP-SMX -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Subsequently, 16 S rRNA gene sequencing identified the organism as Burkholderia pseudomallei with a matching score of 99.8 %.
evidence_items.test_name: Blood culture and 16S rRNA gene sequencing

step10_contradiction_notes: Initial standard library MALDI-TOF score suggested B. thailandensis (1.81), but 16S rRNA gene sequencing resolved the contradiction with 99.8% match to B. pseudomallei, corroborated by clinical severity and sputum/repeat blood cultures.

rationale: A 50-year-old diabetic male in Sri Lanka presenting with left psoas, splenic, and hepatic abscesses. Burkholderia pseudomallei was isolated from psoas abscess aspiration culture, along with high antibody titers (E1 confirmatory). Treated with IV meropenem -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Burkholderia pseudomallei was isolated from psoas abscess aspiration culture and serum showed a significant level of antibodies.
evidence_items.test_name: Psoas abscess aspirate culture and serology

rationale: A 25-year-old female presenting on day 43 postpartum with puerperal sepsis and a tubo-ovarian abscess. Peripheral blood culture, high vaginal swab, and tubo-ovarian pus all isolated B. pseudomallei confirmed by Vitek 2 (E1 confirmatory) -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Blood culture grew   B. pseudomallei   which was sensitive to ceftazidime, meropenem and co-trimoxazole.
evidence_items.test_name: Blood culture, pus culture, and Vitek 2 identification

rationale: A 24-year-old pregnant woman presenting with prolonged fever, hepatosplenomegaly, and hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH). Blood and bone marrow bacterial cultures isolated non-fermenting Gram-negative bacilli confirmed as Burkholderia pseudomallei by PCR-based 16S rRNA gene sequencing (GenBank OP764052; E1 confirmatory). Treated with ceftazidime, dexamethasone, and TMP-SMX with full recovery -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Further identification to the species level was done by PCR-based DNA sequencing of the 16S rRNA gene (GenBank accession number OP764052) and growth of   B. pseudomallei   was reported.
evidence_items.test_name: Blood/bone marrow culture and 16S rRNA sequencing

rationale: A 21-year-old diabetic male presenting with acute respiratory failure, cough, and multiple cavitary lung nodules (thoracic melioidosis / Whitmore's disease). Blood culture and sensitivity isolated Burkholderia pseudomallei within 3 days (E1 confirmatory). Treated with ceftazidime/avibactam, meropenem, and oral TMP-SMX with clinical recovery -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Samples were sent for blood culture and sensitivity, which revealed isolates of Burkholderia pseudomallei within three days, which established the diagnosis of thoracic melioidosis.

rationale: A 31-year-old diabetic male presenting with acute undifferentiated febrile illness, jaundice, altered sensorium, hepatosplenic abscesses, and lung consolidation. Blood cultures confirmed the presence of Burkholderia pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Started on meropenem -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Based on the findings, meropenem was initiated for suspected melioidosis, and later blood cultures confirmed the presence of Burkholderia pseudomallei

rationale: A 57-year-old construction site worker with diabetes and alcohol misuse in non-endemic Australia presenting with cavitary lung disease and septic arthritis of the left elbow. Two peripheral blood cultures, sputum culture, and left elbow joint aspirate culture all grew Burkholderia pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Treated with IV meropenem, joint washouts, and eradication TMP-SMX -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: Two peripheral blood cultures, sputum culture and left elbow joint aspirate culture grew the organism Burkholderia psuedomallei.
evidence_items.test_name: Blood, sputum, and joint aspirate culture

rationale: A 51-year-old diabetic dock worker in Malaysia presenting with lower back pain and a distal aortic mycotic aneurysm with acute rupture. Intraoperative aortic tissue and pus cultures grew B. pseudomallei (E1 confirmatory). Managed with open graft repair, meropenem, ceftazidime, and long-term oral doxycycline -> POSITIVE.

evidence_items.source_quote: intraoperative tissue and pus cultures grew B. pseudomallei, which was sensitive to trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, ceftazidime, doxycycline, and meropenem.
